steps.name: android-display-settings
steps.subject: Display settings on the Android host: physical resolution and the refresh-rate policy
steps.description:
On the Android host the phone's panel belongs to Android. The display KCM shows the physical
resolution next to the rendering one and offers the host's refresh rates (Automatic or a fixed rate),
set through the host's display socket (android-display-client.h, shared with KWin's Android backend);
a fixed rate also selects the matching KScreen mode. Other sessions keep the upstream page.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [Android host specific: the display belongs to the APK host]
